target_scope.interpretation: Predicts the source dataset's Hazardous label, not actual Earth-impact probability.

orbital_rule_diagnostic.interpretation: Strong association with a simple orbital-criteria diagnostic raises a target-label provenance concern but does not establish the exact label-generation procedure.

threshold_selection.objective: Maximize precision among thresholds with positive-class recall >= 0.85

evaluation_protocol.holdout_caveat: Permutation feature importance was later calculated using holdout records. The holdout was therefore not untouched for every post-hoc analysis and should not be used for further model tuning.

model.imputation: Median imputation in the fitted pipeline

development_cross_validation.metric_definition: PR-AUC is reported as average precision; fold standard deviations are descriptive variation across folds.
development_cross_validation.selection_note: The Random Forest had higher mean PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than the Logistic Regression baseline in this grouped cross-validation comparison.

holdout_record_level.interpretation: At threshold 0.2, 127 of 144 positive-label records were identified, while 224 negative-label records were predicted positive. These are predictions of the dataset label, not real-world impact warnings.

holdout_asteroid_level_secondary.aggregation: Average record-level predicted probabilities for each asteroid, then apply threshold 0.2
holdout_asteroid_level_secondary.caveat: The 0.2 threshold was selected using record-level development out-of-fold predictions, not separately optimized for asteroid-level aggregation. These results use a different evaluation unit and should not be compared as though the units were identical.

post_hoc_feature_importance.method: Permutation importance measured as decrease in average precision
post_hoc_feature_importance.caveat: Importance indicates model reliance under this evaluation setup, not causation. It is post-hoc descriptive analysis because it was calculated on the holdout.

limitations: The model predicts the source dataset's Hazardous label, not actual impact probability.
The target closely aligns with an orbital-criteria diagnostic, with exceptions; the exact label-generation procedure is not established.
The 0.2 threshold prioritizes positive-class recall but produces many false positives.
Future-data and external-dataset generalization have not been established.
Predicted probabilities have not been established as calibrated real-world risk estimates.
Permutation feature importance was calculated on holdout data; do not use those results for further tuning.
